title: Arrival at the Ghat
description: Orient yourself after the KAALCHAKRA jump.

objectives.text: Speak to the boatman at the river ghat

title: Gather Bazaar Clues
description: Find a social route into the palace.

objectives.text: Speak to the printer about palace protocol
Discuss 1905 Bengal without revealing the future

title: Get Palace Access
description: Use print and reputation to reach the minister.

objectives.text: Return to the printer for a respectful invitation
Use the invitation to get a palace pass from Minister Rahim

title: Avoid Captain Haines
description: Cross the palace court without drawing colonial attention.

objectives.text: Enter the palace outer court while keeping suspicion below 100

title: First Nawab Meeting
description: Ask for the crystal and survive the refusal.

objectives.text: Meet the Nawab and accept the first failure

title: Escape the Palace
description: Use the alley route after the failed meeting.

title: Meet the Sage
description: Learn how to become a custodian instead of a thief.

title: Build Kaal Rishi Reputation
description: Keep your reputation controlled and return to the court.

objectives.text: Return to the Nawab with sage-backed restraint

title: Final Nawab Negotiation
description: Convince the Nawab to release the Shakti Crystal.

objectives.text: Receive permission and collect the Shakti Crystal

title: Return to Present
description: Return to the ghat extraction point.

objectives.text: Reach the river ghat with the crystal
